sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Oversized Furniture and Home Decor

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-Hong Kong Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (IPPA) 1997

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 et seq. and R.561-1 et seq.; Ordonnance n°2016-1635 and Ordonnance n°2020-115 transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843; UBO register regime under CMF Articles L.561-45 to L.561-47 and Décret n°2017-1095; Commercial Code Articles L.123-1 and R.123-13 regarding RCS declarations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy and proof of residential address of each natural person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent administrative authority of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the competent authority; if the issuing state is not party to the Hague Apostille Convention then consular legalization at the nearest French consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of corporate existence and full corporate register extract (Kbis-equivalent or good standing) of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed, where necessary, by sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Executed power of attorney (mandat) authorizing the formation agent or attorney to sign the articles of association and complete RCS filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the foreign principal's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft articles of association (statuts constitutifs) containing appointment of président, capital allocation and registered office authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Filing attorney in France as grantee, executed by all shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Private signature; not required to be notarized unless a shareholder contributes real property as consideration

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, appointed président, and signatories against the U.S. OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Council consolidated financial sanctions list, French National Terrorist Financing list, and TRACFIN typology records. Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) due diligence is mandatory under CMF Article L.561-10, with enhanced monitoring for family members and close associates. Screening evidence must be retained for five years under CMF Article L.561-12.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RCS (Registre du commerce et des sociétés) via the INPI-operated Guichet unique d'entreprises: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; pre-registration name availability through data.inpi.fr and Infogreffe
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name (dénomination sociale) must be written in Latin characters on the RCS application and in the articles of association. Foreign words, trademarks and personal names are permissible if transliterated into accented French/Latin script; all documents filed in French. The name must be distinctive and must not create confusion with a protected trademark or earlier company name. Non-Latin scripts may be used only as an ancillary graphic element and must be accompanied by a French transliteration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No formal statutory name reservation exists in France; a name obtains legal priority only upon successful RCS registration through the Guichet unique. If the INPI/RCS rejects the proposed name, the filer must submit a written statement and corrected name via the Guichet unique within the cure period notified by the registrar. If rejection is maintained, the filer may apply to the juge commis à la surveillance du registre du tribunal de commerce under Commercial Code Article R.123-100 for judicial supervision within 15 days, and thereafter appeal to the cour d'appel. The appeal file must include the INPI trademark search result and evidence of identity of any conflicting company.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a non-licensed e-commerce SAS under Commercial Code Articles L.123-11-1 to L.123-11-6 only through an approved domiciliation agent (gestionnaire de domiciliation) with a BRDA registration number; the provider must certify the reality of an administrative, postal and management address. A mere mailbox without any management substance is not sufficient for tax residence and VAT registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 30% in the first 24 months. Unannounced inspections are unlikely for a low-risk e-commerce importer but rise if the tax authorities question the commercial reality of the domiciliation address, if turnover thresholds trigger VAT audit controls under Article L.13 F of the Livre des procédures fiscales, or if oversized-freight logistics records are inconsistent with import customs declarations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and trademark pre-search (INPI/Infogreffe database review, conflict risk memo)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for name clearance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of legal notice in an authorized legal gazette (journal d'annonces légales) in the department of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory prefectural tariff per insertion line

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI/Guichet unique RCS registration fee including tax and greffe charges
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Article A.123-17 of the Commercial Code

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration and Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs filing (included in the RCS application; no separate fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff; zero marginal cost because bundled with RCS registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English-to-French or source-language-to-French sworn translation of articles, apostilled powers of attorney and UBO identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per certified page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille/consular legalization authentication bundle (passport copies, corporate good standing, POA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Hague authorities of foreign shareholders or French consulates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular/authentication tariffs of issuing countries plus courier fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year registered office and commercial domiciliation service (letter-box office with scanning and mail forwarding)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for non-unlicensed retail domiciliation in Ile-de-France

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal advisory fee for drafting SAS articles, shareholder protocol, UBO/AML identification, director appointment and RCS filing submission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for standard SAS incorporation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (France), Book II on commercial companies, Articles L.227-1 through L.227-26 governing the Société par Actions Simplifiée (SAS); application of Book I general company provisions, including L.210-1 to L.210-10 on incorporation and corporate purpose; R.123-1 et seq. on RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered-office department, operating the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); the single electronic filing portal is administered by INPI as the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (articles of association) signed by the initial shareholders together with the standardized M0/DPA electronic declaration submitted through the INPI Guichet Unique; registration is evidenced by the Kbis extract issued by the Greffe.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SAS has no statutory minimum paid-up capital; the articles may lawfully set the capital from EUR 1. Cash contributions must be fully paid up before filing and deposited in a blocked statutory bank account in France or held with a notary until the Kbis is obtained; SAS shares must be fully subscribed and fully paid at issue. In-kind contributions require a valuation report by a commissaire aux apports unless a statutory derogation applies, and the registrar will verify the capital release rule before registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE INITIAL SHAREHOLDERS OF [SAS], a société par actions simplifiée. FIRST: the shareholders confirm that the share capital of €[•], divided into [•] ordinary shares, has been fully subscribed and paid as recorded in the deposit certificate; the subscription is accepted and the shares are definitively allotted. SECOND: the registered office is fixed at [address], France. THIRD: [Name] is appointed Président of the SAS with the power to legally bind the company and to carry out all acts permitted by law and the Articles. FOURTH: the Président is expressly authorized to complete all registration, publication, tax, social, banking and regulatory formalities of incorporation and to sign every document required for that purpose. FIFTH: these resolutions take immediate effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked capital deposit and subscription of shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or notary authorized to receive statutory deposits; no government authority participates at this stage.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open an account in the name of the future SAS and deposit the full cash capital. Provide the bank or notary with the draft statuts, shareholder identification, source-of-funds evidence, and corporate KYC pack. Obtain the attestation de dépôt de fonds recapitulating the amount and the future corporate name. For in-kind contributions, instruct a commissaire aux apports to issue a valuation report before signature of the statuts.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts used for the deposit
Identity and proof of residence of each founding shareholder
Source-of-funds statements and bank KYC forms
Attestation de dépôt de fonds issued by the bank or notary
Commissaire aux apports valuation report if any contribution is in kind
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the blocked-account certificate due to AML/KYC queries, provide enhanced evidence of the lawful origin of funds or transfer the deposit to a notary's escrow account. If the valuation report is challenged, apply to the President of the Commercial Court for a recours against the proposed valuation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, signing and legalization of the statuts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders and legal counsel; optional notary for authentic deeds but not mandatory for a cash-funded SAS.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the statuts in French containing the corporate name, form, share capital, share classes, registered office, corporate purpose covering online retail and home delivery of oversized furniture and home decoration, duration, governance of the presidency, rights attaching to shares, and approval of annual accounts. Each shareholder must sign every page or use a qualified eIDAS-compliant electronic signature. Foreign signatories must attach certified/apostilled identification and, where documents are not in French, provide a French translation by a certified translator.
required_dossiers: Final statuts in French duly signed by all shareholders
Power of attorney or mandate if a representative signs
Certified translations and apostilles for foreign shareholders and officers
Beneficial owner data to be used in the declaration of beneficial ownership (RBE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a defect in the statuts is later identified by the registry, adopt an acte rectificatif signed by the same shareholders before the expiry of the filing procedure and upload it via the Guichet Unique in response to the registry's query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First corporate decisions, appointment of the Président and establishment of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial shareholders or the sole shareholder; landlord or domiciliation company for the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the pro-forma first resolution adopting the subscriptions, fixing the registered office, appointing the first Président, and granting banking and incorporation powers. Obtain documentary proof of lawful enjoyment of the siège social, being either a lease, a free-use agreement, a commercial domiciliation contract, or the shareholder's occupation title if the office is at the founder's home. Record in the minutes the term of office, any limitation on powers and, if desired, the appointment of a directeur général.
required_dossiers: Pro-Forma First Board Resolution or procès-verbal of the initial shareholder decision
Lease agreement, domiciliation contract or landlord attestation covering the registered office
Valid identity document and address proof of the appointed Président
Acceptance letter of the Président and, if applicable, of the directeur général
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the domiciliation provider withdraws its attestation, immediately secure a replacement address and execute a supplementary written decision relocating the registered office before the RCS filing. If the chosen Président refuses appointment, appoint a substitute by the same consent procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of the incorporation dossier with the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), which transmits the file to the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the Guichet Unique and enter the corporate data: legal form SAS, share capital, registered office, NAF/APE code 47.91, Président identity, beneficial owners and banking details. Upload all mandatory attachments, complete the standardized M0/DPA dataset, and pay the official state fees online. The portal validates the envelope and routes it electronically to the territorial Greffe where the registered office is located.
required_dossiers: Signed statuts
Attestation de dépôt des fonds or notary deposit certificate
Commissaire aux apports report if in-kind contribution was made
Proof of registered office (lease, free-use agreement or domiciliation certificate)
Identity document and residential proof of the Président
Declaration of beneficial owners (RBE) extracted from legal documentation
M0/DPA electronic declaration generated on the portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet Unique issues a notice of incompleteness or rejection, cure the deficiencies within the imparted delay by re-uploading corrected documents in the same electronic file. If the portal fails, contact the INPI helpdesk and request a written incident reference to preserve the date of filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration, INSEE identification and issuance of the Kbis extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) and Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques (INSEE).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Greffe conducts the legality review of the statuts and corporate governance documents, registers the SAS in the RCS, and triggers INSEE identification. Upon admission, the company receives SIREN, SIRET, and the APE classification code; the Kbis extract and registration notification are served electronically through the Guichet Unique and are simultaneously shared with tax and social administrations.
required_dossiers: Electronic filing receipt from the Guichet Unique
Kbis and RCS application pre-filled by the Guichet Unique
Proof of payment of registration and CCI taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS registration is refused, request the precise grounds and file a rectified dossier; if the APE code is incorrectly allocated, apply for correction with INSEE. A persistence refusal may be challenged before the President of the Commercial Court within the legal deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, social security, VAT and banking integration after registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DGFiP (direction générale des finances publiques), URSSAF, and the commercial bank holding the operational accounts.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registration, DGFiP will normally notify the corporate tax account and the VAT regime; the company must verify the opening of its impôt sur les sociétés file and, if engaging in intra-Community or export transactions, request a French intra-Community VAT number if required. Confirm URSSAF registration as an employer if hiring staff, and close the blocked capital account by producing the Kbis so that the funds become freely available. Update the bank's KYC with the Kbis, the identity of the bank signatories and the corporate authorization to open the final current account.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
SIREN/SIRET notification
Corporate bank account opening forms and authorized signatory resolution
Professional liability and property/transport insurance certificates
If hiring: URSSAF employer registration data
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or social accounts are not visible after 10 days, request reactivation through the Guichet Unique or write to DGFiP/URSSAF with the Kbis. If the bank retains the blocked funds, provide the Kbis and a copy of the current banking mandate; failure to release funds may be raised through the bank's internal disputes procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Conditional industrial, environmental and occupational screening for warehousing and logistics
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement), Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours (SDIS), Inspection du Travail, and the local municipal authority for land-use compliance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify whether any storage or logistics site used for furniture and home decoration goods crosses the French installations classées thresholds under ICPE Rubrique 1510 for solid combustible materials. If the thresholds are exceeded, file the appropriate déclaration or demande d'enregistrement with DREAL before stocking. Conduct the fire safety visit with SDIS or a registered safety controller, validate structural capacity of racking and storage areas, and ensure Code du travail compliance for employee safety, electrical installations, manual handling and emergency routes. Keep waste disposal manifests and, if the site receives the public, comply with accessibility and ERP safety rules.
required_dossiers: Registered office and warehouse lease or ownership documentation
Site plans, building structure certificate and racking calculation notes
Fire safety and evacuation dossier prepared for SDIS or the commission de sécurité
Waste transfer and disposal manifests
ICPÉ declaration or registration file under Rubrique 1510 if thresholds are crossed
Occupational health and safety assessment and electrical conformity certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DREAL or the fire authority issues a formal notice, suspend the non-compliant activity and submit a regularization package under the Code de l'environnement, complying with the mise en demeure timeline; engage an approved technical bureau to certify corrective works and request cancellation of the notice once compliance is achieved.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL — Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement; SDIS fire safety brigades; Inspection du Travail; no industrial operating license authority applies to the pure online retail activity itself.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for online retail of oversized furniture and home decor under ISIC 4791/NAF 47.91. If the company operates a warehouse crossing ICPE storage thresholds, the relevant titles are the Déclaration ICPE or the Enregistrement ICPE under Rubrique 1510 for solid combustible materials; no manufacturing or industrial operating permit is applicable.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL — Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement, within the Ministry of Ecological Transition.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for the commercial e-commerce activity and for small depots below the ICPE Rubrique 1510 thresholds; a regulatory Déclaration or an Enregistrement, with a simplified environmental impact examination, is required for larger storage capacities of combustible furniture and packaged goods; a full EIA report is not generally required for this sector.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Article R.512-1 et seq. of the Code de l'environnement and the relevant ministerial arrete for installations classées; wastewater discharges to the public sewer must respect the limits imposed by the local arrêté and Articles L.1331-10 and L.1331-11 of the Code général des collectivités territoriales; VOC and dust emission thresholds are not triggered by uncoated furniture storage, but firewater containment and runoff retention must be provided; waste handling, manifests and disposal must follow Article R.541-45 of the Code de l'environnement.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety visitation and residential/ERP compliance must be obtained from SDIS or the local commission de sécurité where applicable; structural load inspections are required for mezzanines, racking and temporary storage structures; occupational clearance under Articles L.4121-1 et seq. of the Code du travail covers electrical installations, emergency exits, ventilation, manual handling of oversized goods, and accident prevention planning. Warehouses employing personnel must register with the competent workplace health and safety authorities and maintain a safety log.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) under the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial Sovereignty — professional taxpayer portal: impots.gouv.fr (Portail Professionnel); customs, export declaration and import VAT authority: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) — portals: douane.gouv.fr and deltas.douane.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a French-established SAS: incorporate electronically through the Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); INSEE automatically issues the SIREN/SIRET identifiers and DGFiP automatically allocates the intra-Community French Value Added Tax number (FR + 11 digits) — no separate VAT application is required for the French-established entity; the EORI number is obtained separately from DGDDI for customs purposes. For a non-established foreign seller: file the VAT registration application directly with the Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères (SIEE), CS 70016, 93077 Noisy-le-Grand Cedex, using Cerfa No. 13862*03, with proof of identity, foreign registration, bank details, and stated French activity; a non-EU established seller not using the special OSS scheme must appoint an accredited VAT fiscal representative (représentant fiscal) under Article 289 A CGI, who is jointly and severally liable for French VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The SAS is mandatorily subject to French corporation tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS) at entity level; no US-style check-the-box election exists in France. Available statutory elections and mechanisms: (i) tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) under Article 223 A CGI for a group head holding at least 95% of French subsidiaries; (ii) temporary option for personal income tax (IR) treatment for newly created or innovative small SASs under Articles 239 bis AA and 239 bis AB CGI (subject to turnover and holding-period conditions); (iii) VAT group election creating a single taxable person (assujetti unique) under Article 256 C bis CGI, effective since 1 January 2023; (iv) option to tax otherwise exempt property lettings under Article 260 CGI; (v) hybrid mismatch neutralization in accordance with ATAD provisions (Articles 30, 30 bis CGI) for intragroup arrangements, while the actual election to treat a foreign entity as fiscally transparent is made under the foreign jurisdiction's tax law (e.g., US check-the-box) and produces French re-characterization consequences only.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée — TVA), governed by Directive 2006/112/EC as transposed in Code Général des Impôts Articles 256 to 322
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For a French-established SAS: VAT registration is mandatory from the first taxable transaction with no monetary threshold (Article 286 CGI), subject to the small-business exemption franchise en base de TVA under Article 293 B CGI, which exempts predominantly goods-supplying traders up to the applicable franchise limit (currently EUR 85,000 of annual turnover, with the legislated increase to EUR 91,900 deferred to 1 January 2027 by the Loi de Finances pour 2024); for intra-Community distance sales of goods to non-VAT-registered consumers in other Member States, a union-wide EUR 10,000 annual threshold applies before the seller must account for VAT in the destination Member State through the OSS scheme; a foreign supplier not established in France has a zero registration threshold for French distance sales from the first transaction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing under the French reform: from 1 September 2026 all large and mid-size entities, and from 1 September 2027 all small entities including SASs, must issue B2B e-invoices through a certified Platforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP) or the public billing portal (Portail Public de Facturation / Chorus Pro), with simultaneous e-reporting of B2C transaction data to DGFiP; France does not operate per-invoice real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping comparable to Hungary, Romania or Italy, but e-reporting of transaction-level data is mandatory and B2C transaction data must be transmitted within ten days of the transaction; all cash-register and point-of-sale software used for retail B2C receipts must be certified under the anti-fraud software standard (NF 525) if receipts are generated on the seller's premises, while e-commerce platforms issue compliant electronic receipts/invoices; imports of oversized furniture into France are cleared electronically through the DGDDI DELTA-X/SOPRANO system, with the option for registered importers to defer import VAT under Article 1695 CGI.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (exonération) applies under Article 262-1-I-1° CGI to sales of goods, including oversized furniture, dispatched or transported outside the European Union by or on behalf of the seller (true export), provided the seller holds documentary proof of physical export; intra-Community supplies to a VAT-registered customer established in another EU Member State are exempt under Article 262-1-I-2° CGI if the seller obtains the customer's valid EU VAT number, issues an EC sales list entry, and evidences dispatch of the goods out of France; distance sales to non-VAT-registered EU consumers cannot be zero-rated and must be reported through the OSS regime at the destination-State rate; related freight, handling and ancillary services directly supporting the exported goods are also exempt under Article 262-1-II-1° CGI; services supplied to customers established outside the EU generally fall outside the territorial scope of French VAT under the B2B place-of-supply rule (Article 259-1 CGI) rather than being zero-rated as exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU/Déclaration en Douane EX-A) bearing the Movement Reference Number (MRN)
Commercial Invoice (explicit export sale, Incoterms, value, buyer and consignee identity)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR consignment note evidencing physical transport
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent banking evidence of receipt of export proceeds
DGDDI Customs exit confirmation or carrier proof of dispatch to the non-EU destination
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP applies strict documentary scrutiny to export zero-rating claims, cross-checking customs exit declarations against VAT returns and banking records; where substantiation is defective or fraudulent, the supply is recharacterized as taxable within France and the VAT is retrospectively clawed back (rappels de TVA), with intérêts de retard (0.2% per month) and statutory penalties: 10% for unintentional inaccuracies, 40% for bad faith (mauvaise foi) under Article 1729 CGI, and 80% for fraudulent maneuvers or abuse of law (abus de droit) under Articles 1729-0 CGI and L64 LPF; erroneous EC sales list declarations trigger supplementary fines under Article 1788 A CGI; fraudulent export schemes expose criminal tax fraud prosecution under Article 1741 CGI (up to five years imprisonment and EUR 75,000 fine), customs confiscation and fines under the Code des Douanes, and the assessment limitation period is generally six years (Articles L169 and L180 LPF), extended to ten years for concealed or fraudulently suppressed transactions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France is France's central bank and part of the Eurosystem. The European Central Bank sets euro-area monetary policy. The French Treasury (Direction générale du Trésor) administers relevant financial and monetary regulations, including certain international financial sanctions and reporting obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is freely convertible. France applies no general exchange controls on current-account payments, capital movements, or profit and dividend remittances, subject to EU law, financial sanctions, anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing requirements, tax rules, and applicable reporting obligations. A French SAS may generally remit dividends after lawful corporate approval and satisfaction of distributable-profit, withholding-tax, and documentation requirements. Cross-border payments involving non-EU jurisdictions may require additional bank documentation. Foreign direct investment screening may apply to acquisitions or investments in specified sensitive activities; ordinary online furniture retail is not generally a screened activity, but the facts and investor status must be checked.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general export-proceeds surrender requirement, mandatory conversion ratio, or statutory conversion deadline. Export receipts may be retained in euros or foreign currency, subject to contractual, tax, customs, accounting, sanctions, and bank compliance requirements. Banks may request invoices, customs evidence, contracts, and an explanation of payment purpose.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; Capital Deposit Account for formation capital where required by the formation process
Operational Account; Capital Deposit Account for formation capital where required by the formation process

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and relevant regional Crédit Agricole caisse

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium to high for routine euro collections, card acquiring, and payments where the provider is authorized in the EU/EEA and passported or otherwise lawfully operating in France. An electronic money institution account is not a bank deposit and generally does not provide the same deposit-guarantee protection as a credit institution account. Provider limits, safeguarding arrangements, permitted services, currency coverage, chargeback reserves, and access to SWIFT or local clearing must be verified. Offshore digital EMIs without appropriate EU authorization or passporting are not a compliant substitute for a French corporate bank account. Stripe and Affirm are payment or financing providers, not substitutes for the SAS's regulated operating bank account; availability and underwriting are subject to their terms.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not generally require directors to appear physically at a bank to open a corporate account. Remote onboarding may be offered, subject to the bank's risk assessment, identity-verification methods, electronic-signature standards, and beneficial-owner checks. A bank may require an in-person appointment, certified or apostilled foreign documents, or a locally resident contact as a policy matter. Formation capital may be deposited with an eligible bank or other legally permitted depositary, subject to its onboarding process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder, director, or ultimate beneficial owner; opaque ownership chain; or inability to identify natural-person beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current group ownership chart through to natural-person beneficial owners; shareholder register; constitutional documents and good-standing evidence for corporate owners; passports and proof of residential address; beneficial-owner register filing evidence; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; and certified translations, apostilles, or legalization where requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contribution or incoming transfer inconsistent with the stated business, investor profile, or transaction purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed subscription or contribution documents; board or shareholder resolutions; bank statements showing origin of funds; audited accounts or tax returns supporting source of wealth; investor identification; transfer instructions identifying the SAS and contribution purpose; and a clear funds-flow schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border payments, unusual third-party payments, high-risk jurisdictions, sanctions exposure, or payment flows inconsistent with furniture retail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier and customer contracts; commercial invoices and purchase orders; shipping and customs records; counterparties' corporate and beneficial-ownership details; sanctions-screening evidence; transaction-monitoring rationale; expected-volume forecast; and written controls prohibiting unexplained third-party receipts and payments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Online retail exposure, card-not-present transactions, elevated refunds or chargebacks, or use of BNPL and payment-service providers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Website and terms of sale; product and delivery descriptions; consumer-protection and returns policies; payment-provider agreements; fulfillment and proof-of-delivery procedures; refund and chargeback monitoring controls; fraud-screening procedures; and forecast sales, ticket size, and chargeback ratios.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete French corporate registration, inconsistent company information, or lack of a credible French business nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kbis extract or equivalent current RCS evidence; articles of association; SIREN/SIRET and VAT details when issued; registered-office evidence; director appointments; business plan; supplier and logistics arrangements; warehouse or fulfillment agreements; and evidence supporting the stated operating address.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder capital through an account in the SAS's legal name or the authorized formation-capital depositary, using SEPA Credit Transfer for euro payments within SEPA and SWIFT for other cross-border transfers. Identify the payer, SAS, currency, and purpose consistently as share subscription or shareholder contribution; provide subscription documents, corporate resolutions, beneficial-owner information, and source-of-funds evidence. Confirm the receiving bank's required payment references and any correspondent-bank charges before remittance. France has no universal statutory FX purpose-code system for ordinary corporate transfers; do not invent a code. The bank may require its own purpose classification and supporting documents. Record the contribution and any foreign-currency translation under applicable French accounting and tax rules.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer where available for eligible euro payments within SEPA; use SWIFT MT103 for international customer credit transfers, with appropriate correspondent-bank details and sanctions screening. Settle supplier invoices against contracts, purchase orders, invoices, and shipping or customs evidence. For documentary trade, arrange a commercial letter of credit through a bank, subject to bank approval and applicable UCP 600 terms; documentary collections may use URC 522 where agreed. Use SEPA Direct Debit only with valid mandates. Reconcile payment references to invoices and maintain records for accounting, VAT, customs, and AML review. SWIFT MT103 is a payment message, not a settlement rail or guarantee.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards for documented commercial exposures, subject to counterparty approval, suitability and disclosure requirements, and applicable EU derivatives rules.
Non-deliverable forwards where legally available and appropriate for a documented exposure; they settle the difference in an agreed currency and do not convert or deliver the restricted currency.
Foreign-exchange swaps for short-term liquidity and currency-management needs, subject to documentation, counterparty limits, and applicable EU derivatives rules.
Currency options, where offered and suitable, subject to product-risk disclosure and governance controls.

Hedging should be proportionate to forecast or committed business exposures rather than speculative. The SAS should document exposure, approval limits, counterparties, valuation, accounting treatment, and any applicable EMIR reporting, clearing, risk-mitigation, and MiFID II obligations; applicability depends on transaction and counterparty classification.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (Article 219-I CGI; standard rate applicable since 1 January 2022 following the phased reduction from 33.33%).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs (turnover < EUR 10m, capital fully paid up, ≥75% held by individuals); Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% capped EUR 100m per company (35% where total eligible expenses exceed EUR 100m); Innovation Tax Credit (CII) 20%; royalty/patent 'box' regime at 10% effective rate on net qualifying IP income; indefinite loss carryforward (annual cap EUR 1m + 50% of excess) and one-year carry-back limited to EUR 1m.
